numbers_and_tables.detail: docs/experiments/e7b_serial_efficiency.md line 103 gives E7a's additive full_pipeline_ms for the CLIP globals as "6.34-6.35 ms". The stored E7a values (results/experiments/e7a_efficiency/results.json points) are concat 6.34318, vocab1000_product 6.34593, fusion 6.35788; at the sentence's 2-dp precision the upper end rounds to 6.36, so the range should read 6.34-6.36 (or 6.343-6.358). This sentence is unchanged since 1e883b4 (not part of the round-1 fixes), and the derived claims hold exactly: gap 1.27-1.33 ms ("about 1.3 ms") and 20.0-20.9 per cent ("about 20 per cent"). No conclusion is affected.
numbers_and_tables.title: Pre-existing rounding truncation in the E7a comparison range "6.34-6.35 ms"

numbers_and_tables.detail: Recomputing the sample sd (ddof=1) from the stored per-seed list [0.57493, 0.57221, 0.57234] gives 0.001534 -> 0.00153, versus the published 0.00154. The published value is copied verbatim from the source aggregate (e8a core_analysis per_arm_summary A1 std_dev_accuracy 0.00154), which is correct at full precision: the accuracies are 4435/4414/4415 correct over 7714 rows, whose exact sample sd is 0.0015357 -> 0.00154. The fix promised the column verbatim from the source aggregates and delivers exactly that; all seven other rows agree under both computations. Recorded only so a future auditor does not re-flag it.
numbers_and_tables.title: e8a_a1 sd 0.00154 is not reproducible from the stored 5-dp per-seed values alone (source-precision artefact, not an error)

provenance_and_consistency.detail: docs/experiments/e7b_serial_efficiency.md gives per-stage heads as "head 0.03-0.09"; the smallest head-stage median across systems is question_only at 0.0366 ms, which rounds to 0.04 at two decimals.
